title: STEVE LUCAS
tickerText:
This channel? I have no idea, really. I am just trying to pull together the last 45 years of my life in the music industry.
There are songs and clips of X (the Australian one), Bigger Than Jesus, and various other bands I have fronted or participated in. There are links to streaming channels that look after my releases, past, present, and future... Yeah, it is a bit shambolic, but so am I.
There are things I like to listen to, songs I have enjoyed over the years... influences, etc.                                                                      
Steve Lucas is the voice at the centre of X, the Sydney punk band that hit the ground running in 1977. After the death of guitarist Ian Krahe, Lucas took up guitar as well, helping drive the raw attack of X-Aspirations and At Home with You. He’s kept moving through solo work and bands including Bigger Than Jesus, Double Cross and The Groody Frenzy — still making music with the same restless, no-fuss spirit that made X matter.
